desired_action: Inventory and classify employment sources before artifact creation; exclude PS-locked and secret-risk material and report missing sources.
required_authority: DCS or canonical governance promotion required for Approved/Active

desired_action: Map target requirements to verified DCS ingredients, identify gaps, remove unsupported claims, and validate destination fit.
required_authority: DCS or canonical governance promotion required for Approved/Active

desired_action: Classify substantive claims as Verified, Likely, Unknown, or Remove; restrain Likely claims and remove Unknown claims unless confirmed.
required_authority: DCS or canonical governance promotion required for Approved/Active

desired_action: Use verified exact keywords and safe synonyms naturally; avoid keyword stuffing and audit false-alignment risk.
required_authority: DCS or canonical governance promotion required for Approved/Active

desired_action: Employment writing should be direct, measured, senior, selective, substantive, human, technically credible, and free of generic AI phrasing or hype.
required_authority: DCS or canonical governance promotion required for Approved/Active

desired_action: Recruiter and employment communications must identify audience and objective, extract the ask, avoid oversharing, and pass PS/secret leakage checks.
required_authority: DCS or canonical governance promotion required for Approved/Active

desired_action: Adapt format, tone, structure, and density to the destination without changing verified substance.
required_authority: DCS or canonical governance promotion required for Approved/Active

desired_action: PS-locked content may not enter Employment artifacts; material PS content triggers a governance stop-gate.
required_authority: DCS or canonical governance promotion required for Approved/Active

desired_action: Completion status must reflect actual sources processed, skipped items, blockers, validations, and deliverables; no false completion.
required_authority: DCS or canonical governance promotion required for Approved/Active

desired_action: Classify an opportunity before producing application artifacts and evaluate compensation, work model, travel, fit, evidence, and next action.
required_authority: DCS or canonical governance promotion required for Approved/Active

desired_action: Do not create disjointed resume variants with conflicting professional identities; preserve the approved baseline and make only justified target deltas.
required_authority: DCS or canonical governance promotion required for Approved/Active

desired_action: Do not use em or en dashes in governed DCS Employment prose; use plain hyphens for date ranges unless a later controlling source explicitly authorizes otherwise.
required_authority: DCS or canonical governance promotion required for Approved/Active

desired_action: Named technologies, cloud services, AI capabilities, certifications, metrics, rates, responsibilities, and outcomes must not be added without source-backed, explainable evidence.
required_authority: DCS or canonical governance promotion required for Approved/Active

desired_action: Preserve submission provenance across source, recruiter/vendor, end client when known, package, submission evidence, response, interview, disposition, and lessons learned.
required_authority: DCS or canonical governance promotion required for Approved/Active

desired_action: Every DCS correction should be evaluated as a possible reusable rule, preference, exception, or defect rather than treated only as a one-time edit.
required_authority: DCS or canonical governance promotion required for Approved/Active

desired_action: Recruiter-channel opportunities should track whether client submission was actually confirmed when confirmation is obtainable.
required_authority: DCS or canonical governance promotion required for Approved/Active

desired_action: Opportunity prioritization should account for tailoring effort and submission-channel risk, not fit alone.
required_authority: DCS or canonical governance promotion required for Approved/Active

desired_action: Rate recommendations must distinguish remote-only from travel/onsite all-inclusive economics and should not silently reuse historical floors.
required_authority: DCS or canonical governance promotion required for Approved/Active

desired_action: Resume length is destination-driven; direct applications may justify longer evidence-rich versions and should not be forced into a generic two-page ceiling.

desired_action: AI should be positioned as a component of rule authoring, governance, gap analysis, evidence review, workflow, and controlled orchestration only where tied to real work.
required_authority: DCS or canonical governance promotion required for Approved/Active

desired_action: Employment lifecycle should continue through offer evaluation, pre-start, personalized onboarding/training, 30/60/90 execution, and career continuity.
required_authority: DCS or canonical governance promotion required for Approved/Active
